preflight.host.unavailable.en: The current installation could not be independently verified. No database upgrade was started. Contact trusted support.

apply.apps_missing.en: A required part of the updated system is missing. Do not use the system; contact trusted support.

apply.counts_unavailable.en: Existing records could not be counted before the update. The update stopped to protect your data.

apply.health_failed.en: The updated system did not pass its health check. Use the recovery instructions; do not delete data.

apply.migrate_failed.en: The supported database upgrade did not finish. Do not start the ERP again until you follow the recovery instructions.

apply.records_lost.en: The update would have reduced existing school records, so it was stopped. Your files are preserved. Contact trusted support.

apply.role_desk_missing.en: A role desk page is missing after the update. Do not use the system; contact trusted support.

apply.site_invalid.en: The installed site could not be opened safely, so the update stopped. Nothing was deleted.

channel.disabled.en: The provider has paused updates for this installation. Your data was not changed.

channel.invalid.en: The update address configured by the provider is not safe. No update was downloaded.

compat.downgrade.en: The offered update is not newer than the installed version. Nothing was installed.

compat.engine_schema_unsupported.en: The update format is not supported by this installation. Nothing was installed.

compat.host_updater_too_old.en: This computer's update tool is too old for the new release. Ask your provider for a new package.

compat.installed_too_new.en: The installed version is newer than this update supports. Nothing was installed.

compat.installed_too_old.en: This update cannot be applied directly to such an old version. Contact your provider.

compat.installed_version_unknown.en: The installed version could not be identified, so the update was refused.

compat.schema_unsupported.en: The database version does not match this update's supported path. Nothing was installed.

compat.sequence_gap.en: This update needs an earlier update first. Contact your provider.

engine.request_invalid.en: The update request was not valid, so nothing was done.

engine.unexpected.en: The updater stopped safely because of an unexpected problem. Nothing was deleted.

policy.release_not_authorized.en: This update is not authorized for a real school installation. Nothing was installed; your data is safe.

policy.release_not_production.en: This is a test update package, not an approved release. Nothing was installed.

preflight.backup.artifact_invalid.en: A backup file is missing or changed. The update was refused; nothing was changed.

preflight.backup.receipt_invalid.en: The backup record does not prove a complete encrypted backup on a separate drive. Nothing was changed.

preflight.backup.receipt_missing.en: No verified encrypted backup was found. A current backup is required before an update. Nothing was changed.

preflight.backup.receipt_unreadable.en: The backup record is damaged and cannot be read. Nothing was changed. Contact trusted support.

preflight.backup.stale.en: The last verified backup is too old for this update. Make a new backup, then try again.

preflight.disk.insufficient.en: There is not enough free disk space for a safe update. Free some space or contact your provider. Nothing was installed.

preflight.image.identity_mismatch.en: The installed program does not match its saved record. The update was refused.

preflight.image.missing.en: The installed program image was not found. Contact trusted support. Nothing was changed.

preflight.not_installed.en: TOEFL House ERP is not installed on this computer. Use Install instead.

preflight.recovery.authorization_expired.en: The Owner recovery authorization has expired. Obtain a new authorization, then try again.

preflight.recovery.authorization_invalid.en: The Owner recovery authorization is not valid. Nothing was installed.

preflight.recovery.authorization_missing.en: Signed Owner recovery and key-custody authorization is missing. The update was refused.

preflight.recovery.approval_missing.en: Both recovery approvals are required. One approval alone cannot authorize an update.

preflight.recovery.approval_invalid.en: The recovery approvals are not from two distinct authorized approvers. Nothing was installed.

preflight.recovery.request_replayed.en: This recovery request was already used. Obtain fresh approvals from both approvers, then try again.

preflight.recovery.binding_mismatch.en: The recovery authorization belongs to a different backup or site. Nothing was changed.

preflight.recovery.key_custody_unverifie.en: Owner encryption-key custody is not verified. The update was refused.

preflight.recovery.rehearsal_unverified.en: A successful practice recovery is not verified. The update was refused.

preflight.services.unhealthy.en: The running system is not healthy, so the update was refused to avoid damage. Restart it normally and try again.

preflight.site.config_missing.en: The existing site files are incomplete. Do not update or reinstall. Contact trusted support.

preflight.site.config_unreadable.en: The existing site could not be checked safely. Nothing was changed.

preflight.site.credentials_missing.en: The saved database password is missing. Do not reinstall. Contact trusted support.

preflight.update_in_progress.en: A previous update did not finish. Use the recovery instructions before starting another update.

preflight.volume.missing.en: The database storage on this computer is missing. Stop and contact trusted support. Your records were not touched.

preflight.volume.unverified.en: The database storage could not be confirmed. Start Docker Desktop and try again. Nothing was changed.

release.archive.hash_mismatch.en: The downloaded update is damaged or was changed. It was not installed.

release.archive.identity_mismatch.en: The update program does not match the signed release. It was not installed.

release.archive.missing.en: The update program files are missing. Nothing was installed.

release.archive.size_mismatch.en: The downloaded update size does not match the signed release. It was not installed.

release.image.labels_mismatch.en: The update version labels do not match the signed release. It was not installed.

release.manifest.invalid.en: The update details are damaged or not supported. Nothing was installed.

release.manifest.missing.en: The update details could not be found. Nothing was installed.

release.signature.invalid.en: The update did not pass its provider authenticity check. It was not installed.

trust.invalid.en: The provider trust information on this computer is invalid or damaged. No update was installed.

trust.key_expired.en: The provider's signing key is not valid for this date. Ask the provider for an updated package.

trust.key_unknown.en: The update was signed by a key this installation does not trust. Nothing was installed.

trust.not_provisioned.en: The update service is not yet configured by the provider. No update was checked or installed.

warning.backup_age_near_limit.en: The last verified backup is getting old. Make a new backup after the update.

warning.not_rollback_safe.en: Database changes cannot be undone automatically. A verified backup and recovery authorization are required.

apply.identity_mismatch.en: Related ERP records no longer line up after the upgrade. The update needs a recovery decision; nothing was deleted.

apply.installed_mismatch.en: The installed version changed while the update was being prepared. Nothing was migrated.

apply.evidence_mismatch.en: The backup or recovery evidence changed after it was verified. Nothing was migrated.

apply.archive_mismatch.en: The downloaded update file no longer matches the verified release. Nothing was migrated.

transaction.missing.en: The update was not authorized on this computer. Nothing was changed.

transaction.invalid.en: The update authorization record is not usable. Nothing was changed.

transaction.expired.en: The verified update expired before it was applied. Run Check for Updates again.

transaction.mismatch.en: This computer or release changed after the update was verified. Nothing was migrated.

transaction.replayed.en: This update step was already used. Nothing was changed; start Check for Updates again.

transaction.unknown.en: This update authorization was not issued by the application. Nothing was changed.

transaction.tampered.en: The update authorization was changed after it was issued. Nothing was changed.

apply.host_unsafe.en: The computer changed while the update was being prepared. Nothing was migrated; start Check for Updates again.

apply.journal_unsafe.en: Another update is not finished yet. Nothing was migrated; wait for it or start Check for Updates again.

updater.already_running.en: An update action is already running. Wait for it to finish.

updater.applying.en: Installing the verified update and checking your records. Do not close or restart this computer.

updater.cancelled.en: The update was cancelled. Your system was not changed.

updater.checking.en: Checking the provider's trusted update channel...

updater.completed.en: The update finished and your records were preserved. You can open the ERP normally.

updater.disk_check_failed.en: Free disk space could not be checked. Nothing was changed.

updater.download_failed.en: The download did not finish correctly, so it was discarded. Your system was not changed.

updater.downloaded.en: The update was downloaded and checked. It is ready to install.

updater.engine_failed.en: The update safety check did not finish. Nothing was installed. Contact trusted support.

updater.engine_missing.en: The verified update program could not be started. Nothing was changed. Contact trusted support.

updater.failed.en: The update stopped safely. Your data was not deleted. Read the recovery steps before trying again.

updater.guard_blocked.en: TOEFL House ERP was not started because an update is unfinished. Open Check for Updates and read the recovery steps.

updater.hold_production.en: Real school records cannot be updated until the Owner acceptance and release gates are complete.

updater.idle.en: No update has been checked yet.

updater.installed_version_unknown.en: The installed version could not be read. Contact trusted support; do not reinstall.

updater.interrupted.en: A previous update did not finish. The ERP is protected to avoid damage. Follow the recovery steps.

updater.network_failed.en: The update service could not be reached. Your system was not changed. Check the internet and try again.

updater.no_release.en: The provider has not published an update yet.

updater.not_configured.en: Updates are not configured yet. Ask your provider to finish the release setup.

updater.not_installed.en: No installed ERP was found, so there is nothing to update. Use Install on a new computer.

updater.package_invalid.en: The update package failed its safety check. Nothing was installed.

updater.ready.en: Checks passed. Installing the update now. Keep this window open.

updater.recovery_required.en: The update needs a recovery decision. Do not reinstall or delete anything. Follow the recovery steps.

updater.recovery_steps.en: Do not delete data, reinstall, or reset Docker. Keep this folder and contact trusted support with the safe status.

updater.rollback_blocked.en: The database was already upgraded, so it cannot be rolled back automatically. Follow the recovery steps and contact trusted support.

updater.rollback_done.en: The update was not applied. The previous working version was restored; your records were not changed.

updater.signature_required.en: The update must be signed by the provider before it can be installed. This package was not signed.

updater.stopped.en: The ERP services are stopped while the update state is resolved.

updater.up_to_date.en: This computer has the newest available release.

updater.verifying.en: Checking the update signature and program files...

label.hold.en: Updates stay disabled until the Owner release gates are complete.
